title: Find where the derivative is zero
text: An equilibrium solution is a constant solution, so its derivative is $$0$$. Set the right side of the equation equal to $$0$$ and solve.

title: Factor out $$P$$
text: $$P'=P \left(0.4-\frac{P}{25000}-0.6\right)=P \left(-0.2-\frac{P}{25000}\right)$$. This is $$0$$ when $$P=0$$ or when $$\frac{P}{25000}=-0.2$$, which is $$P=-5000$$.
